item.description: Sung Kang says he was inspired by the death of his friend and costar Paul Walker to engage the car community and make a brand-new racing movie, whose teaser trailer debuted exclusively with IGN.

item.title: Razer Viper V4 Pro Review
item.description: The Razer Viper V4 Pro is a powerful gaming mouse with incredible accuracy that’s perfect for competitive gamers, but you’ll have to come to terms with its minimalism.

item.title: The Furious Exclusive Red Band Trailer: This Martial Arts Movie Starring Xie Miao and Joe Taslim Looks Insane
item.description: IGN can exclusively reveal the new red band trailer for The Furious, an action film currently sitting at 100% fresh on Rotten Tomatoes after premiering at last year’s Toronto International Film Festival. The film stars Xie Miao (The New Legend of Shaolin, My Father Is a Hero) and Joe Taslim (Mortal Kombat, The Raid) is directed by Kenji Tanigaki (Enter the Fat Dragon, Master of Thunder).

item.title: Marvel Confirms The Punisher: One Last Kill Special Presentation Release Date
item.description: Marvel has announced a release date for The Punisher: One Last Kill, its upcoming one-off special starring Jon Bernthal's gun-toting antihero, ahead of his appearance in Spider-Man: Brand New Day.

item.title: Devil May Cry Showrunner Says Season 2 Is Like the Difference Between Batman Begins and The Dark Knight
item.description: If there’s one thing showrunner Adi Shankar wants to impress upon fans about the upcoming second season of Netflix’s Devil May Cry, it’s that the animated series is getting much bigger. So much so that Shankar is comparing it to the gulf between 2005’s Batman Begins and its 2008 sequel, The Dark Knight.

item.title: Payday: Aces High Is a New 4-Player Co-op VR Game Coming to Steam and Meta Where You Can 'Pull Off Daring Jobs in VR Using Black-Market Tech'
'XCOM Meets Papers, Please and Door Kickers' – Arbiter 131 Announced for PC
item.description: Introducing Arbiter 131, a real-time tactical sci-fi strategy sim for PC by developer Ikon with a narrative focus in which you play as the titular Arbiter, analyzing citizen data to prioritize targets and remotely commanding police units. The question is, will you follow orders?

item.title: Uri Tupka and the Gods Is a Sequel to One of 2025's Best Graphic Novels
item.description: Hellboy creator Mike Mignola is expanding his newest shared universe with the release of Uri Tupka and the Gods, and we've got an exclusive preview of the new book.
